svg.title: Runtime and PM2 process topology
svg.desc: Server-host, subprocess, PM2, node-agent, supervisor, PROot application, and release/projection process ownership.

a.xlink:title: hosts process (Local process)
durable delivery (JetStream)
admits release work (IPC)
starts app process (Local process)
starts/supervises (Local process)
starts/supervises (Local process)
same-origin /apps path (HTTP)
routes /api/lite/* (HTTP)
PROot Ubuntu application container. Hosts verified applications such as PhotoPrism without making documentation tooling or the browser a runtime dependency.
PhotoPrism. Provides the verified managed photo application under a same-origin Caddy path.
FastAPI /api/lite/*. Validates requests, owns safe read APIs, admits commands, and never delegates browser execution directly to NATS or shell.
Lite node agent. Connects to NATS, publishes heartbeat/telemetry/health, handles device commands, and reconnects after outages.
Lite agent supervisor. Runs separately from the agent, reads the protected agent environment, and starts or restarts failed agents without overwriting identity.
NATS / JetStream. Provides the command and event backbone with durable delivery; it is never contacted directly by the frontend.
a.text: is never contacted directly by the...

a.xlink:title: Worker process. Consumes durable commands and owns backend execution for apps, security, recovery, releases, and lifecycle work.
Release subprocess. Owns network, download, verification, staging, apply, and rollback work outside the FastAPI event loop.
Projection subprocesses. Own CPU-heavy projection reconstruction and serialization outside the API process.
PM2 process manager. Starts and supervises approved server-host and joined-device processes with bounded restart policies.
Caddy same-origin proxy. Serves the PWA and routes /api/lite/* and managed app paths without exposing backend secrets.
tailscaled daemon. Owns Tailscale networking; startup scripts may detect/start it safely while read APIs remain side-effect-free.
